intro: Professionals and everyday users convert teaspoons (us) (tsp) to milliliters (mL) when working across us_customary and metric standards in culinary recipe scaling, beverage bottling, laboratory reagent preparation, and fluid tank capacity sizing. One teaspoon (us) equals 4.928922 milliliters, while 1 milliliter equals 0.202884 teaspoons (us). Whether you are verifying volume & liquid specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: US Customary vs. British Imperial Liquid Volume Trap
items: US Customary and UK Imperial liquid units share identical names but have different physical volumes: 1 US Gallon is 3.78541 L (128 US fl oz), whereas 1 UK Imperial Gallon is 4.54609 L (160 Imp fl oz) — a 20.1% difference.

Similarly, 1 US Pint contains 16 US fluid ounces (473.18 mL), while 1 British Imperial Pint contains 20 Imperial fluid ounces (568.26 mL). Always verify whether your recipe, pump datasheet, or vehicle spec sheet uses US or UK standards.

faqs.question: How many milliliters (mL) are in 1 teaspoon (us) (tsp)?
faqs.answer: There are 4.92892159 milliliters (mL) in 1 teaspoon (us) (tsp), which rounds to 4.9289 mL for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 milliliter equals 0.202884 teaspoons (us).

faqs.question: How do I convert teaspoons (us) to milliliters (tsp to mL)?
faqs.answer: To convert teaspoons (us) to milliliters, use the formula: mL = tsp × 4.92892159. For example, converting 1.5 tsp gives 7.3934 mL.

faqs.question: What is 1.5 teaspoons (us) in milliliters?
faqs.answer: 1.5 teaspoons (us) (tsp) equals exactly 7.3934 milliliters (mL) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
